problem.title: Minimum Add to Make Parentheses Valid

approaches.title: One-pass parenthesis balance tracking
approaches.summary: Scans the string once while tracking unmatched parentheses and counting additions needed. Revision 1 is an incorrect net-count approach because it ignores ordering; later revisions correctly handle unmatched closing and opening parentheses.

revisions.commitComment: naive solution, fails to account for order
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 921!: naive solution, fails to account for order
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduced a net balance count and returned its absolute value. Incorrect because the final balance does not capture invalid prefix order.
Replaced net counting with a greedy scan that counts unmatched closing parentheses and remaining unmatched openings.

revisions.commitComment: refactored into functional fold expression for fun
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 921: refactored into functional fold expression for fun
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Refactored the same greedy balance algorithm into a functional fold with tuple state.
Simplified the balance state to unmatched openings and required closing insertions, decrementing openings when possible.
